messages:
julia_sales: Quick ask from FinRise legal: need a minimal compliance bundle for the POC next week. They want SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 proof, signed pen-test attestation referencing testing window and 'no outstanding critical findings' language, a one-page network diagram, and staging access instructions. Also asked if Dedicated supports single-tenant isolation and rough uplift.

mike_seccops: On it. Plan to assemble: redacted SOC2 summary, ISO cert screenshot, draft pen-test letter, network diagram + blast radius note, staging creds doc + KMS separation blurb. Drafting pen-test attestation now. Who signs it?

nina_eng: For signatory, Head of Security signs. I'll produce the network diagram and include the ephemeral staging creds command and sample allowed endpoints. Note: staging creds TTL defaults to 7d and are read-only.

tom_ps: Dedicated single-tenant option is available (reserved pool + VPC peering). Uplift ballpark +30% for short POC; final quote depends on GPU type and burst. I'll send the estimate to you, @julia_sales.

julia_sales: Legal also wants the attestation to name the testing window and confirm no outstanding criticals at issuance. Can we include that in the draft?

mike_seccops: Draft template ready: ```
[Company Letterhead]
Date: [MM/DD/YYYY]
To: [Customer]
Subject: Penetration Test Attestation

This confirms that Redwood Inference retained [vendor] to perform a penetration test covering the scoped production and staging systems between [start] and [end]. At the time of this letter there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities for the scoped systems that would materially impact confidentiality, integrity, or availability.

Signed,
[Head of Security]
```

I'll route to Legal for sign-off.

legal_bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: https://box.internal/redwood/finrise-poc-evidence-v1.zip (sales+security view). :package:

nina_eng: Staging snippet I'll include: `./infra/tools/create-staging-creds --project finrise --role read-only --ttl 7d` plus sample JSON of allowed inference endpoints. Also add note on masked logs / default retention.

julia_sales: Can we get signed letter by Thursday? We promised quick turnaround.

mike_seccops: Escalating to Legal now. If no major redlines expect signature by Thu EOD. :thumbsup:

julia_sales: Perfect. I'll send the bundle and note the signed letter is forthcoming. Clarify scope limited to POC env.

mike_seccops: Added clarification in the letter that attestation is scoped to the tested environment; SaaS-wide attestation is separate.

[thread closed]
